%iso(vista, k, ox, oy):
  c:cos(π/6)
  s:sin(π/6)
  if vista=="T":
    T:[c,-c,0;s,s,0;0,0,1]
  elif vista=="L":
    T:[c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  else:
    T:[-c,0,0;s,1,0;0,0,1]
  M:[T_(1,1),T_(1,2);T_(2,1),T_(2,2)]
  Q:M*transpose(M)
  th:0.5*atan2(2*Q_(1,2); Q_(1,1)-Q_(2,2))
  m1:(Q_(1,1)+Q_(2,2))/2
  m2:sqrt(((Q_(1,1)-Q_(2,2))/2)^2+Q_(1,2)^2)
  s1:sqrt(m1+m2)
  s2:sqrt(m1-m2)
  dt:det(M)
  if isa(k; "circle"):
    C:T*[k.c.x;k.c.y;1]
    point("P"+k.c; ox+C_1; oy+C_2)
    point("A"+k+"a"; ox+C_1+k.r*s1*cos(th); oy+C_2+k.r*s1*sin(th))
    point("A"+k+"b"; ox+C_1-k.r*s2*sin(th); oy+C_2+k.r*s2*cos(th))
    ellipse("P"+k.c; "A"+k+"a"; "A"+k+"b")
  else:
    for i in 1..k.n:
      o:k_i
      if isa(o; "line"):
        A:T*[o.a.x;o.a.y;1]
        B:T*[o.b.x;o.b.y;1]
        point("P"+o.a; ox+A_1; oy+A_2)
        point("P"+o.b; ox+B_1; oy+B_2)
        line("P"+o.a; "P"+o.b)
      elif isa(o; "arc"):
        r:hypot(o.a.x-o.c.x; o.a.y-o.c.y)
        C:T*[o.c.x;o.c.y;1]
        A:T*[o.a.x;o.a.y;1]
        B:T*[o.b.x;o.b.y;1]
        point("P"+o.c; ox+C_1; oy+C_2)
        point("P"+o.a; ox+A_1; oy+A_2)
        point("P"+o.b; ox+B_1; oy+B_2)
        point("A"+o+"a"; ox+C_1+r*s1*cos(th); oy+C_2+r*s1*sin(th))
        point("A"+o+"b"; ox+C_1-r*s2*sin(th); oy+C_2+r*s2*cos(th))
        if dt<0:
          earc("P"+o.c; "A"+o+"a"; "A"+o+"b"; "P"+o.b; "P"+o.a)
        else:
          earc("P"+o.c; "A"+o+"a"; "A"+o+"b"; "P"+o.a; "P"+o.b)
  k
